text:
elaine: Heads-up: BigFinancial escalation — legal wants 99.99% SLA + dedicated instances for renewal. Sales says deal at risk if we don't commit. See https://redwood.internal/sales/bigfinancial-sla

matt: 99.99% is heavy. Need perf numbers. What’s their QPS and burst profile?

sasha: They're on staging now. Renewal in 21 days. They've pushed to execs.

ryan: If we give dedicated it's ~4xA100 equivalent and infra cost ~ $25k/month. Rollout time ~4 wks.

matt: That timeline breaks other Q2 launches. We should compute RICE tradeoff.

elaine: Agree. Quick RICE for 'Dedicated SLA for BigFinancial': Reach=1 (single customer), Impact=3 (high revenue), Confidence=0.6, Effort=3 (dev months). RICE = (1*3*0.6)/3 = 0.6

sasha: Score looks low vs platform roadmap items. Sales: can we offer interim mitigations to keep them?

ryan: Mitigation options: reserved burst capacity + prefix caching, or soft SLA 99.9% with dedicated routing for critical traffic. Can deliver soft path in ~10 days; full dedicated ~4 wks.

elaine: Proposed commercial compromise: sign 6-mo renewal at higher rate with 99.9% now, 99.99% after traffic validation + fee for dedicated capacity.

matt: Need launch criteria: p99 latency < 250ms under their profile, failover tested, and cost-per-token impact < 20% of revenue margin. Also need infra runbook.

sasha: I'll push for the compromise in exec call. If they demand 99.99% now, we need signed TCV uplift or escalation to CTO.

elaine: Plan: (1) Run RICE spreadsheet and solidify numbers, (2) Matt/Ryan to produce feasibility + timelines by EOD tomorrow, (3) Sasha negotiates with customer using proposed compromise. @matt @ryan @sasha

ryan: :thumbsup: I'll add infra options and rough cost to the shared doc.

matt: I'll add perf harness and dev-month estimate.

sasha: Drafting renewal note now, will share before EOD.

dev-bot: Reminder: deployment freeze window next Friday 00:00-06:00 UTC.

elaine: :eyes: Noted — timeline may need a small extension. Thanks all.
